titleText: JTF News: BBC News, ABC News Australia
mainText: A senior Islamic State leader was killed in a joint operation by the United States and Nigeria.
President Trump warned Taiwan against declaring independence following a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
Lebanon reports six deaths in an Israeli strike; the United States announces a ceasefire extension.
Ebola outbreak reported in Democratic Republic of Congo
A blackout occurred in Cuba's eastern province following a power grid collapse.
